evidence.reason: The current renderer still recognizes an ExecStart directive only when the physical line begins exactly with `ExecStart=`. systemd ignores whitespace around `=`, so a valid template containing `ExecStart = ...` produces zero matches and raises `ValueError('unit must have exactly one ExecStart: ...')`. This remains a routine implementation defect; no supplied contract or fixing commit supersedes it.
